content:
The problem with this trace is that any intermediary in that chain might as well be a P2P ownership transfer, and the FBI could end up knocking down the doors of some unsuspecting randos who bought some coins off an anon from the internet (which is precisely how you're supposed to do bitcoin, btw).

Doubtful that anyone pulling off a theft like this would be dumb enough to deposit in a CEX, though I very much hope for CC victims that this is the case.
